skill.name: dotnet-cpp-localizer
skill.description: Comprehensive internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n) for .NET and C++ applications. Generate resource files, manage translations, and implement best practices for multi-language support.

generated_query:
I’m building a multilingual ASP.NET Core MVC web app that currently has all UI strings hardcoded in English. I need to add support for Japanese, Spanish, and German. Could you help me set up internationalization? Specifically:

- Generate the necessary `.resx` resource files for each language (English as default, plus `ja`, `es`, `de`), organized under `Resources/Controllers/`, `Resources/Views/`, and `Resources/Shared/`.
- Provide the `Program.cs` configuration for `IStringLocalizer`, view localization, and cookie‑based culture selection.
- Walk me through extracting all hardcoded strings from my existing controllers and views, and show how to replace them with localizer calls using placeholders like `{0}` for dynamic values.
- Also include a method to let users switch languages from a dropdown, persisting their choice in a cookie.

My project uses .NET 8, so please make sure the setup works with the latest patterns.
